records.text: Sigmund Freud knew children were being abused in Vienna and created psychology to gaslight those children.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Freud knew that the children were being abused in Vienna and he created a social science psychology to help gaslight those children.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Freud encountered patient reports and theories involving childhood sexual abuse, but the compound claim that he knew abuse was pervasive throughout Vienna and created psychology specifically to gaslight victims attributes a broad prevalence finding and deliberate motive that the historical sources do not establish. The historical premise has support; the motive/conspiracy conclusion does not.

sources.title: Jeffrey Masson and Freud's seduction theory: a new fable based on old myths
sources.relevance: Scholarly review of Freud's seduction theory and the contested historical interpretation; does not substantiate the alleged deliberate gaslighting motive.

records.text: Sigmund Freud was a Satanist who created a social science.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I told you Sigmund Freud was a Satanist. He created a social science.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. Freud founded psychoanalysis, but authoritative biographical sources describe him as atheist or secular and provide no evidence that he was a Satanist. Calling psychoanalysis social science is also imprecise; the composite statement combines a real intellectual role with an unsupported label.

sources.title: Formative Years — Sigmund Freud: Conflict & Culture — Library of Congress
sources.relevance: Identifies Freud neurological and psychoanalytic work and describes his secular life.

sources.title: Freud and Religion — Freud Museum London
sources.relevance: Documents Freud atheism, contrary to the unsupported Satanist label.

records.text: Sigmund Freud explicitly said that elites create science to mask their religion, which consists of ritual sacrifice and harming children.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Sigmund Freud is explicit that they create the science to mask their religion. Their religion consists of ritualistic sacrifice, harming innocent children.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. Exact-phrase and concept searches of Freud scholarship and primary-text resources found no attributable passage in which Freud says elites created science to mask a religion of sacrifice and child harm. Without a work or citation, the alleged statement cannot be authenticated.

records.text: Modern psychology was created by German mystical Jews who practiced the occult.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: a social science that was created, to be very clear, ... by German mystical Jews, ... They believed in mystical Judaism. They were practicing the occult.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed (host, direct claim). APA's history timeline identifies Wilhelm Wundt's 1879 Leipzig laboratory as the beginning of formal scientific psychology and documents numerous founders and milestones. That directly contradicts the categorical claim that modern psychology was created by a group of German mystical Jews practicing the occult.

sources.title: American Psychological Association History Timeline
sources.relevance: Authoritative field history identifying Wundt's laboratory and the multi-person development of scientific psychology.

records.text: The Assault on Truth lays out a direct relationship between modern psychology, child abuse, and trauma-based mind control.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Club all about the very dark history of modern psychology and its direct relationship to child abuse, ... trauma-based mind control. ... That's what the book The Assault on Truth lays out.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed (host, direct citation). The publisher/book description confirms The Assault on Truth concerns Freud's seduction theory, child sexual abuse, and later adult mental illness. It does not support the added claim that the book lays out trauma-based mind control. The child-abuse component is supported; the mind-control component is not.

sources.title: The Assault on Truth: Freud's Suppression of the Seduction Theory
sources.relevance: Book metadata and synopsis confirm its actual child-abuse/Freud subject matter but not trauma-based mind control.

records.text: The author of The Assault on Truth controlled the Sigmund Freud Archives and lost his career for warning about what the scientists knew.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: This person wasn't just an author that was guessing when he wrote this book. He was in control of the Sigmund Freud archives and lost his entire career just trying to ring the alarm on what these scientists knew.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed (host, direct claim). The Supreme Court's Masson v. New Yorker opinion confirms Jeffrey Masson was hired as projects director of the Sigmund Freud Archives and was terminated after publicly advancing his theories. He did not 'control' the archives, and the claim that he lost his entire career is overstated; he continued as an author and independent thinker.

sources.title: Masson v. New Yorker Magazine, Inc., 501 U.S. 496 (1991)
sources.relevance: Official court opinion confirms Masson's projects-director role and termination.

sources.title: The Assault on Truth: Freud's Suppression of the Seduction Theory
sources.relevance: Documents Masson's subsequent publishing career and describes his archive role.

records.text: Operation Paperclip was about rescuing wealthy occult figures such as Sigmund Freud and calling them scientists
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It was about rescuing wealthy occult perverts like Sigmund Freud and his boys, referring to them as scientists, saying that they had scientific breakthroughs so they could go on doing perverted things and go on being the elites. The same families.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. National Archives records define Paperclip as postwar recruitment of German/Austrian specialists. Freud fled Nazi Austria for Britain in 1938 and died in 1939, before Paperclip; he was not rescued by that program.

sources.title: Nazi War Crimes Interagency Working Group: Interim Report
sources.relevance: National Archives description contradicts the claim that Paperclip rescued occult figures such as Freud.

sources.title: About the Freud Museum London
sources.relevance: Documents Freud's 1938 flight to Britain and final year there, before Operation Paperclip.

records.text: Freud and the early psychoanalytic community dismissed genuine patients' reports of rape as fantasy.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They were gaslighting people that were actually being raped.

verification.notes: Owens's accusation invokes the disputed historical interpretation associated with Freud's abandonment of the seduction theory and later cover-up critiques. Scholarship establishes that Freud changed his theory and that historians sharply dispute what patients reported, what Freud inferred or reconstructed, and whether the cases prove actual abuse that he knowingly recast as fantasy. The surviving evidence does not support a confident finding that the broadly described patients were in fact being raped and then deliberately 'gaslit' by Freud and the early psychoanalytic community. This verification was attempted and is marked unverifiable rather than carrying forward the unsupported legacy true/high result; the original history remains preserved in legacy_claim_provenance.

sources.title: The seductions of history: sexual trauma in Freud's theory and historiography
sources.relevance: Peer-reviewed historical analysis describes the historiographic dispute around Freud, sexual trauma, and the seduction theory rather than establishing the broad proposition as fact.

sources.title: The myth of Freud's ostracism by the medical community in 1896–1905
sources.relevance: Historical scholarship challenges important parts of the later cover-up narrative and documents how Freud reconstructed alleged scenes, underscoring that the episode's stronger accusation is disputed.
